name: nginx-multisite
description: Provisions Nginx with three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, static document roots, redirects, security headers, compression, per-site logs, and security hardening including fail2ban, UFW, SSH, and sysctl controls.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, logging, service enablement, and custom configuration handling.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Provisions the FastAPI application stack with Python tooling, Git, PostgreSQL, a virtual environment, application dependencies, database credentials, environment configuration, and a Uvicorn systemd service.
